critical_code_review_comments: early.py credit_referral: on referred participant, referrer's referral_points is incremented by referrer_points; this is fine semantically (referral_points represents 'points earned from referrals'), but consider that on the referred user, referral_points is also set to referred_points — meaning both sides use the same field name for different sources; documentation-only nit.

vip_check tier logic uses max(rank(new), rank(old)) — good, prevents downgrade — but this couples vip_wallet/volume_usd/vip_chains to the LATEST check which may not correspond to the tier displayed (best-of). Consider storing the best-tier wallet+volume snapshot too, otherwise UI shows a wallet with lower volume alongside a higher tier badge earned earlier.

REF_KEY is stored in localStorage in useEffect on mount; if user navigates via SPA link that doesn't remount EarlyAccess, ref won't be captured. Currently mount is on load so OK, but consider capturing ref globally in App.jsx once.
ReferralBox referrer's referral_points display could double-count if the referred user later completes a daily task (referral_points untouched), fine — verified idempotent.
